_note: THE FIRST CHAIN, LINK 2 of 2. Spec: home-office office/projects/delves/chains.md.
MB50a (live, reviewed 10-29) ends with Noor's hand-in talk. Once `next` exists, her first reply gains the ask:
"That's exactly it. Give me an hour and we'll have running water again. Ah, can you do one more thing? Take the
old one to the scrapper. They'll give us something for it." Accepting starts this link. MB50a's live text is NOT
changed until the field is real.
HIS TWO OUTLAWS FAULTS, answered here: (1) not one beat again: MB50a was craft then talk, this is pickup then a
different talk at a new place. (2) the link is CAUSED by the last job, not just offered by the same face: the
regulator the player replaced is the thing he carries, and the close pays off the first job's 'nobody out here
Pay: easy. A small warm coda, not a second job's worth.

beats.journal: I've got the <Place>'s old pressure regulator. I need to take it to the scrapper at the <SecondPlace>.
say: That's the one. Mind it, it's older than both of us.

beats.objective: Sell the old regulator to the scrapper at the <SecondPlace>

person.name: Oskar Lindqvist
person._template: STAND-IN: a male worker template, Eliza's to confirm it resolves.
hellos: If it's broken, I'll look at it. If it's working, why are you here?

greeting: Is that a reclaimer regulator? Let me see. They stopped making these before I was born.

reply: More broken than most things are working. Take this back to them, and tell them it went to a good home.

exchanges.prompt: It's worth more than that, and we both know it.
reply: It is. And you know what I'd say if you weren't standing there. Fine. A little more. Don't tell anyone I'm soft.
Nobody can make the parts inside it any more. Somebody always needs one, and I know who.

exchanges.prompt: What will you do with it?
reply: Take it apart very slowly, and write down everything I find.

beats.journal: I sold the <Place>'s old regulator to the scrapper at the <SecondPlace>, for more than anyone expected.
say: For that old thing? Really? Keep a share, you've earned it.

broadcast: It's the heavy one. Mind your back.
